summary: V10 smoke test PASSED in a real browser. /login renders the admin sign-in form correctly (no stuck 'Loading...' spinner). Admin login (admin@example.com/admin123) succeeds, workspace chooser appears, 'Go to Dispatch Portal' navigates to /dashboard/dispatch. All requested admin pages load with data: Dispatch Schedule (/dashboard/dispatch/schedules, 5 records), Invoices (/dashboard/dispatch/invoices, 4 invoices), Payment SO (/dashboard/dispatch/payment-so, client list), Wage Report (/dashboard/dispatch/reports, 2 records with financial data), Audit Log (/dashboard/dispatch/audit, 105 entries). Client portal login (info@arseas.com/Client@123) at /client-portal/login succeeds, dashboard renders with client-scoped stats. All client portal pages load: Payment SO (/client-portal/payments), Wage Report (/client-portal/wage-report), Invoices (/client-portal/invoices), Company Profile (/client-portal/profile) - all scoped to Arseas Security Services INC. Backend /api/health healthy; POST /api/auth/login returns 200 for both accounts; /api/auth/me returns 401 quickly without cookie (expected). No blocking console errors, no failing (non-auth-me) /api/* responses observed. The user's prior 'stuck on Loading...' was a screenshot-tool XHR limitation, not a real bug.

issues: Recurring warnings: 'WebSocket connection to wss://.../api/ws/dispatch failed: closed before connection established.' Non-blocking but noisy; consider disabling in preview or fixing WS upgrade in ingress.

action_items: No blocking issues. Optional: silence or fix /api/ws/dispatch WebSocket failures observed in browser console (does not affect functionality).
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend routes are nested under /dashboard/... (e.g., /dashboard/dispatch/schedules, /dashboard/dispatch/reports, /dashboard/dispatch/audit). Task description referred to paths like /dispatch/schedule and /reports/wage-report which do not exist. This is not a bug (deep links work with the actual paths) but documentation/menu labels should be kept aligned.
Admin dashboard's initial /api/auth/me returns 401 twice on cold load before login (visible in Network) — expected due to GuestRoute checkAuth, but consider suppressing the console error noise.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@example.com/admin123 (super_admin). Client: info@arseas.com/Client@123 (Arseas Security Services INC).
context_for_next_testing_agent: V10 is fully functional in real browsers. Admin routes are nested under /dashboard/dispatch/* (schedules, invoices, payment-so, reports, audit). Client portal routes: /client-portal/{dashboard,today,schedules,calendar,officers,post-sites,vendors,payments,wage-report,invoices,profile}. Workspace chooser modal appears for super_admin after login — click 'Go to Dispatch Portal' or 'Go to Employee Portal'. WebSocket /api/ws/dispatch fails harmlessly.
rca of the issue: User reported concern about /login being stuck on 'Loading...' spinner. Root cause: user's lightweight screenshot tool could not complete the /api/auth/me XHR from GuestRoute's checkAuth(), so the guest-route Suspense/loading state never resolved. In a real browser (Playwright/Chromium), /api/auth/me returns 401 in ~200ms, checkAuth sets isLoading=false, and the login form renders normally. No fix required.
